classes.title: Classes
classes.description: {year} classes, class teachers and subject teachers.

create.title: Add a class
create.sectionHint: e.g. C, or a stream code for A/L

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Daily class attendance. Parents of absent students are sent an SMS when attendance is saved.

sheet.title: Attendance · {className}
sheet.notYet: Not marked yet for this day. Everyone starts as present — tap to change.
sheet.smsQueued: {count, plural, =0 {No absence SMS needed.} one {# absence SMS queued to parents.} other {# absence SMS queued to parents.}}
sheet.future: You can't mark attendance for a future date.
sheet.readOnly: You can view this sheet but only the class teacher can change it.

exams.title: Term tests & marks
exams.description: Teachers enter term-test marks per class and subject. Submitted sheets are locked.
exams.noSheets: You have no mark sheets for this term test.

sheet.title: {subject} · {className}
sheet.hint: Enter a mark from 0 to 100, or AB if the student was absent. Marks save as a draft until you submit.
sheet.submitBody: Once submitted the sheet is locked. Only an administrator can unlock it.
sheet.closed: Marks entry is closed for this term test.
sheet.unlockBody: The teacher will be able to change marks again. This is recorded in the audit log.
sheet.allRequired: Enter a mark or AB for every student to submit.

reportCards.title: Report cards
reportCards.description: Marks → class-teacher remarks → principal approval → released to parents.

flow.pending_marks: Waiting for teachers to submit marks

class.title: {className} · {exam}
class.approveBody: Marks and remarks will be locked. You can still revert before releasing.
class.approveMissing: {count} students have no remark. Approve anyway?
class.releaseBody: Parents of {count} students will be emailed and can view and download the report card.
class.marksPending: Some mark sheets are not submitted yet. Report cards can be approved once all marks are in.
class.remarkPlaceholder: e.g. Excellent effort this term. Keep it up!

batch.title: {className} · {exam}
batch.description: {count} report cards, one per page. Use your browser's print dialog to print or save as PDF.

promotions.title: Year-end promotions
promotions.description: Move students into their {next} classes. Review repeaters, leavers and A/L streams before confirming.
promotions.basedOn: Averages shown from the latest released or reviewed term test.
promotions.needsTarget: {count} students need a target class (Grade 11 students must be given an A/L stream).
promotions.confirmBody: Saves the plan and sets up {year}: classes (with this year's teachers and subjects), terms a year on, and enrolments. Students stay in their current classes until you start the {year} school year.
promotions.completedBody: Confirmed on {date}: {promoted} promoted, {repeated} repeating, {graduated} graduated, {left} leaving.
promotions.startBody: Students move into their {year} classes, leavers and graduates are marked as such, and {year} becomes the current year. {from} is closed. This can't be undone.
promotions.startsFrom: You can start {year} from {date}, the last day of this school year.
promotions.unplanned: {count, plural, one {# student was} other {# students were}} admitted after the promotions were confirmed. Review the promotions and confirm them again before starting the new year.
